name: Price-up / active-addresses-down divergence -> exhaustion fade short (BTC)
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM: when BTC price makes new highs while btc_active_addresses falls (2025: price ~$87k but active addresses at a 12-month low, -30% from peak), the rally is not backed by organic network demand — it is thin, ETF/derivative-led price with no on-chain participation underneath. This retail-absence divergence historically precedes cooling. The other side is momentum/CTA flow chasing price with no fundamental buyer beneath; the fade harvests the mean-reversion when that flow exhausts. Entry: price stretched to the top of its range (range_position high) AND active addresses low. Fade short; exit on RSI re-cooling or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER 1 (critical confound): active addresses are structurally decoupling from price via L2/Lightning leakage -> if low activity is PERMANENT the signal is always-on and useless; KILL if the activity decline is a one-way secular trend. DISCONFIRMER 2: shorting crypto in an up-trend can blow the DD cap (<=25%). DISCONFIRMER 3: KILL if the divergence has no forward predictive coefficient after BH-FDR. Very high death probability — included to TEST, not to fund. Net of fees, DSR>=0.95.
catalyst: new price highs unconfirmed by active-address participation
